name: chat-thread
title: Chat Thread
description: A conversation plays out as a mountable scene: bubbles pop in on the measured entry, the thread shifts up in expo lockstep, typing dots hold the beat before replies, and a media placeholder stands in for a shared image. Messages are a variable - heights are measured at mount and the choreography is generated to fit
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Contact
variables.description: Name in the thread header; the avatar shows its first letter.

variables.label: Messages
variables.description: Pipe-separated thread. Prefix each entry with recv:, sent: or img (a media placeholder). Example: recv:hey|sent:look 👀|img|recv:amazing
variables.default: recv:what r u using for the launch video??|sent:wait look 👀|img|recv:OMG IT'S HTML|recv:🤯🤯🤯|sent:renders in 4K. no editor

variables.label: Typing dots
variables.description: Show the three-dot indicator before received messages.
